description: Submit a wallet signed withdrawal. Verifies its HMAC permit and signature, checks expiry, and re-simulates before broadcast. Supply the unchanged summary and permit from lp_withdraw_prepare. If the wallet appended extra instructions (e.g. Phantom Lighthouse), also pass unsignedTransaction from lp_withdraw_prepare. High impact requires confirmHighImpact=true.
name: lp_withdraw_submit
title: Submit withdrawal
